completionEvidence.description: /healthz is public; /v1/capabilities without a token and /v1/input with a wrong token both returned HTTP 401.
Capabilities reported displayServer=x11 with screenshot, input and unicodeInput enabled; /v1/desktop returned 1280x800.
Guest Agent /v1/screenshot returned a decodable PNG captured by the Go X11 driver.
After agent click, type_text and enter, the guest file containing the Chinese command output matched the expected UTF-8 SHA256 exactly.

notes: The agent ran as the unprivileged aib user. The token was copied into a 0600 guest file for this prototype; production must issue short-lived scoped tokens and enforce the Per-VM Lease before input.
